sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Automated Dropshipping Networks

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: English common law, French civil law heritage, and customary law; codified companies and finance legislation.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER-Plus (trade and economic integration agreement with Australia and New Zealand; not a stand-alone investor-state BIT)
No comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) with OECD countries is currently in force for Vanuatu.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Financial Transactions Reporting Act, 2002 (FTRA), as amended; International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [No. 20 of 2015]; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and Beneficial Ownership Directive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of natural-person passport or national identity card for each shareholder, director, and controller
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport/national registry authority in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if issued in an Apostille Party; otherwise consular legalization by a Vanuatu diplomatic/consular mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of physical residential address (utility bill, bank statement, or government-issued document) not older than 3 months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, banking institution, or government body in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certification and Hague Apostille / consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source of wealth / source of funds statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank and authorized notary/public accountant in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille / consular legalization; bank reference must be countersigned by the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and board resolution for corporate shareholder (if UBO is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry/corporate registrar of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / consular legalization; English translation certified if source language is non-English

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP (and family/close associate) status verification, OFAC SDN, UN Consolidated Sanctions, EU Consolidated Sanctions, and Vanuatu domestic criminal/sanctions list screening must be completed before any name clearance; enhanced due diligence is engaged automatically for any high-risk jurisdiction, PEP, or nominee relationship; registered agents must refresh the screen at formation and whenever a UBO changes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry online portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Name may be in English or any language using the Latin/Roman alphabet; if a non-Latin script is used, a legalized transliteration/translation into Latin characters must accompany the application; statutory suffix (Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, PTY Ltd, Ltd) required.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the requested name is rejected, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 calendar days of rejection. The appeal must state the grounds on which the name should be accepted, include a fresh name search certificate, and be copied to the objecting Registry officer; the Registrar will issue a final written decision within 21 business days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office; an International Company must maintain a physical registered office at a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu. A non-Vanuatu virtual mailbox may be used for day-to-day business correspondence only.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-high; estimated 15-30% annual probability for automated dropshipping entities that are lightly capitalised and operating exclusively through third-party payment rails, because VFSC may inspect the registered agent's premises and independently validate directors', UBOs', and payment-account control.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC pre-incorporation name search and reservation fee
International Company incorporation / certificate of incorporation fee (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC gazetted fee schedule for International Companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration filing and AML/CDD document acceptance at VFSC and registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission / licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC registration tariff plus market benchmark for registered-agent CDD

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical registered office and registered agent services (first calendar year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a standard international company, annual fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille/consular legalization, and English certification of the KYC/founding-document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign notary/competent apostille authority and Vanuatu consular mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory authentication tariffs in country of origin plus Vanuatu consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening report for all beneficial owners and directors
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT compliance platform or licensed risk provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial refundable-cost screening benchmark per entity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal review of dropshipping scope under ISIC 4791 and confirmation that no statutory license is required
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Premium partner rate for transactional legal opinion (market benchmark)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Stripe/PayPal merchant onboarding documentation support and compliance advice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for payment-rail pre-approval package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier delivery of original apostilled documents from origin country to Vanuatu registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market tariff for IP/DHL/FedEx priority document courier

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 3 (incorporation), 7 (certificate of incorporation), 11 (shares), 18-20 (registered office and registered agent), 29-30 (directors), 36 (company secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement under the Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; a minimum of one share must be issued. No escrow account or statutory capital deposit is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At the First Meeting of the Board of Directors of the International Company held at the registered office in Port Vila, it was unanimously RESOLVED that: (1) the share subscriptions set out opposite the subscribers' names in the register of members be approved and accepted, and that definitive share certificates be issued forthwith; (2) the registered office be established at the office of the licensed Registered Agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu; (3) the directors named in the Articles be and are hereby appointed as the first directors of the Company; (4) [Name] be appointed as Company Secretary; and (5) the directors be authorized to open bank and payment-processor accounts, appoint sub-agents, and execute all agreements necessary for automated dropshipping operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division via a licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names in order of preference through the licensed registered agent. VFSC checks against the national companies register to screen for undesirable, prohibited, or confusingly similar names. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days pending formal incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request letter
List of proposed company names (primary and alternative)
Registered agent engagement letter
Identity and address verification of the proposed beneficial owner (passport and utility bill)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or reserved under objection, submit a fresh alternative name list within 5 business days; VFSC re-runs the pre-clearance at no additional official fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and the standard VFSC template. The subscriber(s) execute the documents in the presence of a witness; the agent then arranges for apostille or notarization where a foreign jurisdiction requires it.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber consent and execution pages
Certified copy of the incorporator's passport
Proof of registered address of the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises comments on the constitutional documents, the registered agent revises the clauses and resubmits within 3 business days; no additional state fee is levied for a first revision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, along with consents of the proposed directors, secretary, and registered agent. The VFSC official filing fee of USD 250 (or equivalent VUV) is paid via bank transfer to the VFSC treasury account. The application is lodged online or in paper form at the VFSC office in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as director (for each director)
Consent to act as company secretary
Consent of the registered agent to act as agent and maintain the registered office
Evidence of payment of the VFSC filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, VFSC issues a deficiency notice; the agent cures the deficiency within 14 days by filing corrected documents or additional evidence. Failure to cure within 90 days voids the application and the fee is forfeited.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar certifies the incorporation, assigns a registration number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated on the day of issuance. The company comes into legal existence on this date, and the Registrar retrieves the registered office particulars into the public register.
required_dossiers: Approved Form IC-1
Certificate of Incorporation (issued by VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains any typographical error, submit a written rectification request with supporting documents; VFSC issues a corrected certificate within 3 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (VFSC-approved corporate services provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent physically maintains the registered office at its licensed address in Port Vila and registers its acceptance with VFSC. The company's statutory records, including the register of members, directors, and charges, are held at this address for inspection as required by law.
required_dossiers: Registered office address confirmation letter
Registered agent certificate of appointment
Register of members and directors (first entries)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent declines or is deregistered, appoint a new licensed agent within 21 days and file Form IC-5 notice of change of registered office and agent with VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Kit and First Board Proceedings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (in person or by written resolution) to adopt the pro-forma first board resolution approving share subscriptions, the registered office, director and secretary appointments, and the opening of bank and payment-processor accounts. Issue share certificates, establish the corporate minute book, adopt a common seal (optional under the IC Act), and file the first board minutes and register of directors with the registered agent.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolutions
Share certificates
Register of directors and secretary
Corporate minute book
Consent forms of first directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the board resolution is challenged by any member, reconvene a board meeting within 7 days with corrected minute entries; minutes must be signed by the chair and retained in the corporate records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no industrial licensing board competent for purely digital dropshipping activities; should physical warehousing be established in Vanuatu, the Vanuatu Chamber of Commerce and the relevant Municipal Council Business Licence office would become competent.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - automated dropshipping without a physical presence in Vanuatu is not a licensable activity under Vanuatu law; the International Company is authorised by its Certificate of Incorporation to conduct electronic-commerce retail operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Environmental Protection Agency - Department of Environmental Protection
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA, registration, or permit required for a zero-footprint digital dropshipping operation with no premises, no manufacturing, and no on-island discharge; any future physical warehouse would require a preliminary environmental screening.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - no wastewater, VOC emissions, or solid waste generated within Vanuatu. If warehousing is later added, waste handling must comply with the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations 2021 and the Ozone Layer Protection Act [Cap. 247] for refrigerants.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for a virtual-only dropshipping operation with no leased physical premises. If an administrative office is subsequently rented in Port Vila, the lessee must obtain a fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu National Fire Services under the Fire Services Act [Cap. 156], a structural load inspection certificate for the office, and a workplace occupational health clearance from the Department of Labour.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (Department of Customs and Inland Revenue), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — official portal: https://www.gov.vu and customs/revenue single-window via ASYCUDA World at https://customs.invanuatu.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is a tax-exempt offshore vehicle excluded from the domestic revenue net; it is not eligible or required to obtain a Vanuatu TIN/VAT ID for pure offshore dropshipping operations conducted exclusively with non-residents. Any foreign entity that instead carries on domestic taxable activity must apply to the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department on Form VAT-REG (Application for Registration), attach the certificate of incorporation, a Business Licence application, evidence of projected taxable turnover, and a resident-agent appointment; where annual taxable turnover exceeds or is reasonably expected to exceed VT 4,000,000, VAT registration is mandatory, and the Commissioner issues a TIN printed on the VAT registration certificate. An IC that illegally engages in domestic supplies may be removed from the exempt registry and retrospectively subjected to the same registration obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu has no check-the-box entity-classification election, no hybrid-mismatch election, no CFC attribution regime, and no fiscal consolidation election. The IC's tax-exempt status is statutory, automatic, and unconditional upon valid incorporation under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; it cannot be waived, opted out of, or varied by shareholder resolution. The only elective feature in the indirect tax system is voluntary VAT registration for a separate domestic trading entity with turnover below the VT 4,000,000 threshold, which is inapplicable to a properly licensed IC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998 (as amended), administered jointly with customs duties by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department; there is no separate GST, sales-and-use tax, or sub-national indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration where the value of taxable supplies in any 12-month period exceeds or is reasonably expected to exceed VT 4,000,000 (approximately USD 33,000); voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold only with Commissioner's consent.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, tax-stamping, SAF-T, Peppol, or state-certified API filing regime is in force in Vanuatu as of the current tax year. Tax invoices are issued in paper or PDF form and must state 'tax invoice', supplier name and TIN, sequential invoice number, date, description, quantity, VAT-exclusive amount, VAT rate, VAT charged, and total price. Customs declarations are submitted electronically through ASYCUDA World; however, an IC engaged in automated dropshipping with no goods landing in Vanuatu customs territory has no local invoicing, clearance, or stamping trigger.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the VAT Act, the export of goods is zero-rated at 0% where the supplier removes the goods from Vanuatu within 28 days of the supply and retains transport documentation; international services supplied to a non-resident for use wholly outside Vanuatu also qualify. Because an IC is wholly exempt from VAT and cannot lawfully make local taxable supplies, it does not charge VAT on export dropshipping flows and has no VAT refund entitlement. The 0% export mechanism is relevant only where a separate registered Vanuatu trading company routes physical goods through Vanuatu customs territory, in which case the exporter must substantiate that it acted as principal, that the goods left Vanuatu within 28 days, and that the customer is a non-resident.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic declaration with unique consignment reference and port departure stamp)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing despatch to the foreign customer within 28 days
Commercial tax invoice describing the goods and confirming zero-rating status
Packing list and shipping carrier manifest proving physical exit from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate, SWIFT MT103, or bank-issued payment evidence connecting sale proceeds to the invoiced export
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Revenue and Customs Commissioner may audit VAT and export records within 5 years of the end of the relevant accounting period under the VAT Act. Where zero-rating is claimed on an export that did not genuinely occur, or where exported goods are diverted back into the local market, the Commissioner may raise an assessment at the standard 12.5% rate on the full supply value, add default interest, and impose civil penalties of up to 150% of the VAT evaded; fraudulent documentation additionally triggers criminal prosecution with fines and imprisonment of up to 5 years. For a Vanuatu IC, any violation of the International Companies Act by conducting prohibited domestic dealings may cause forfeiture of the statutory tax exemption, retrospective application of business-license presumptive taxation, customs import duties on landed goods, and deregistration by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the central bank and foreign exchange administration under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 61] and the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], together with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for licensing and AML/CFT supervision
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains liberal and de facto full convertibility of the Vatu (VUV) for both current and capital account transactions. The jurisdiction has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, meaning no exchange control restrictions apply to payments and transfers for current international transactions. Capital injections, profit remittances, dividends, and liquidation proceeds are freely repatriable without prior central bank approval or withholding tax. The only practical hurdles are standard commercial bank AML/KYC verification, source-of-funds documentation, and transaction threshold reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit where applicable.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None in active force. Vanuatu does not require exporters to surrender export proceeds to the central bank or any domestic bank. There is no mandatory conversion ratio, no statutory repatriation deadline, and exporters may retain receipts in VUV or any freely convertible foreign currency. The historical Exchange Control Act provisions are not applied to international companies, and no RBV approval is needed for offshore settlement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for pure offshore EMI solutions. Vanuatu has no dedicated e-money institution (EMI) licensing framework; a foreign EMI holding or transmitting e-money locally would need to liaise with a licensed domestic bank for custody and integrate with local AML/CFT requirements. Offshore digital wallets have no direct access to local clearing rails and cannot be used as Virul substitute bank accounts. A workable structure is to use an onshore Vanuatu operational bank account as the funding anchor and an offshore merchant processor (e.g., Stripe/PayPal) solely as a receivables-collection tool with periodic settlement into the Vanuatu bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The default statutory and practical mandate requires at least one natural-person director or the ultimate beneficial owner to attend a physical KYC interview at the bank or through an RBV/VFSC-approved introducer, agent, or established correspondent bank. Pure remote account opening is not a statutory entitlement; an applicant may be considered for remote/electronic verification only where the target bank has adopted an exceptional virtual onboarding policy using secure video interviews, notarized/certified identity documents, enhanced due diligence, and independent verification of beneficial ownership. For VU_IC, physical attendance by a director in Port Vila or via an approved regulated introducer materially increases onboarding success.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore international company with no audited local financial statements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, certificate of exemption, registered office and registered agent confirmation, detailed source-of-funds narrative for the initial capital injection, notarized passport copies of directors/UBOs, and a recent bank reference from an introducing regulated financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived opacity or absence of ultimate beneficial ownership information
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date shareholder register and UBO register maintained per VFSC AML/CFT requirements, a notarized UBO declaration showing natural-person ownership percentages, an organizational chart of the ownership chain, certified passports, proof of residential address, and professional letters of introduction from a licensed legal counsel or certified public accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Automated dropshipping model presenting high transaction velocity, cross-border digital payments, and elevated chargeback risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: E-commerce platform agreements (e.g., Shopify, AliExpress, WooCommerce), supplier purchase contracts and logistics invoices, published refund and returns policy, customer dispute escalation procedure, expected monthly transaction volume and average ticket size, historical merchant settlement records, and a compliance policy explaining transaction flows between marketplaces and supplier payment rails.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No genuine physical business presence or economic substance in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence of the registered office and local registered agent, a documented principal place of administration (even where management is delegated globally), board resolutions supporting the VU_IC business purpose, payroll or service agreements with a local corporate administrator, and a clear factual explanation of why an International Company may lack economic substance under Vanuatu law while still maintaining valid legal existence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions from shareholders are routed by SWIFT MT103 from the investor's overseas bank to the VU_IC Capital Escrow Account. The remittance field must identificate the beneficiary as 'VU_IC - International Company', the commercial purpose as 'EQUITY CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' and, where requested, the BoP purpose code 'EC' (equity capital). The receiving bank will verify sanctions status, source of funds through financial institution wire statements, and beneficial ownership data. If the remittance exceeds local reporting thresholds, statutory FIU filings are triggered. No prior RBV approval or exchange-control permit is required; however, to prevent the tracker being treated as a director's loan, the client file must include a share subscription agreement, directors' resolution, certificate of incumbency, and confirmation the funds are credited to a non-interest or escrow-designated account pending allocation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound supplier settlements are cleared through SWIFT MT103 for straightforward open-account payments and trade invoices, or through commercial letter-of-credit operations via SWIFT MT700 (issuance) and MT707 (amendments) where the supplier requires a documentary credit. Because VUV is not a heavily traded currency, cross-border disbursements are typically effected through USD, AUD, or EUR nostro accounts and then converted to the supplier's settlement currency at the bank's prevailing spot rate. The VU_IC operating account may be denominated in foreign currency, and there are no restrictions on selecting the currency of payment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX spot contracts for immediate two-way conversion into VUV, USD, AUD, EUR, NZD, GBP or JPY
Outright deliverable FX forwards (typically 1- to 12-month maturities) on a documented underlying trade or capital exposure
FX forward rollovers and extension contracts offered by the settlement bank's global FX desks
FX swaps (principal exchange and re-exchange at a set future date) available for treasury liquidity management
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for longer-term exposures, available through international bank counterparties and subject to ISDA documentation

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) quotations are only available through offshore non-Vanuatu dealers; the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu does not operate or license a local NDF market because the vatu is deliverable. Onshore banks may, at their sole risk discretion, provide a net-settled VUV/USD forward where the underlying exposure is clearly documented.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal and Annual License Fee for International Company under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), submitted through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable annually on or before each 31 December; renewal cycle administered by the registered agent with reference to the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a penal surcharge of up to 50% of the unpaid annual fee; failure to pay for more than 3 months may result in administrative strike-off from the Register of International Companies, with resulting loss of legal capacity and assets vesting in the Commission under the Act

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation and Register of Members Update pursuant to the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC, lodged exclusively through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Confirmation required at each annual renewal; any change in beneficial ownership or shareholding transfer must be filed within 14 days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance constitutes an offence punishable by fines up to VT 10,000,000 (approximately USD 84,000); persistent default supports agent resignation, administrative strike-off, and deregistration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Renewal Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC / Licensed Registered Agent in Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual license fee; the company must maintain a licensed agent and registered office in Vanuatu at all times during the corporate lifecycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed agent and registered office is a continuing offence; VFSC may issue a notice of default and effect administrative strike-off within 90 days of unresolved non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a standard International Company engaged in retail sale via automated dropshipping networks; a mandatory independent audit applies only to VFSC-licensed entities (bank, insurance, or securities dealer) or where the Commission directly orders an examination of the company's affairs
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as the acceptable accounting framework under the International Companies Act 1992; no statutory obligation to file financial statements with VFSC

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain, record, and file up-to-date UBO particulars with VFSC under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019; every shareholding transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members and reflected in the UBO filing within 14 days of the transfer; an annual confirmation accompanies each license renewal; bearer shares are prohibited

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $850 - $2,500 per annum depending on agent scope, statutory compliance workload, and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily applicable for a standard dropshipping International Company; if voluntarily prepared, a certified audit typically ranges from USD 3,000 to USD 6,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Companies; no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, and no minimum corporate tax. The schema-default 5-year loss carryforward is inapplicable because no CIT computation arises.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory exemption under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]: zero tax on offshore profits, dividends, interest, royalties, and capital gains; zero VAT on ISIC 4791 dropshipping receipts because no supply occurs in Vanuatu; no payroll or social security contributions for the IC. The sole recurring fiscal charge is the annual VFSC government fee plus registered-agent fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (IC AR) submitted via the licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent on the VFSC e-Registry portal. Vanuatu administers no corporate income tax return because the IC is statutorily exempt; the annual filing obligation is the VFSC good-standing return supporting the annual government fee.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual government fee is due on the anniversary date. A 60-day grace period applies before the Registrar of International Companies initiates strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and VFSC/Registrar registration number of the International Company as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must reproduce the name exactly as registered in Latin characters; mismatches with Stripe/PayPal or bank names trigger FATF-style screening failures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part 2 (Box 3-4) - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered-office address in Vanuatu and the name/VFSC licence number of the local licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents cannot substitute their home address or act as registered agent; the Vanuatu agent's office must be the statutory address for service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, date of birth, nationality, and residential address of each director; a single natural or corporate director is permitted with no Vanuatu residency requirement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are fully allowed; provide certified passport and proof of address for the agent's AML file before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of members and ultimate beneficial owners, including share class, percentage ownership, and source-of-funds declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose 100% of the ownership chain; 100% non-resident ownership is expressly allowed. Omission of a trust or nominee layer fails VFSC beneficial-ownership screening.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital: number of shares, classes, par value (if any), and denomination currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital is required; notional USD 100 capitalisation is standard for automated dropshipping entities and must match merchant-account disclosures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu, owns no Vanuatu real property, and that all dropshipping transactions are concluded outside Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No Vanuatu premises, employees, or local customers may be declared; local activity would compromise tax-exempt IC status and trigger 12.5% VAT on domestic supplies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that customer due diligence on all directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners is complete under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2014.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must supply KYC documents, bank references, and an updated structure diagram on every change within 30 days; incomplete records block filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation and payment of the annual VFSC government fee under the statutory fee schedule; first fee payable on incorporation and annually thereafter.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit via the registered agent in VUV or USD equivalent; this is a fiscal charge, not an income tax, and no profit declaration is required for a properly offshore IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a statutory surcharge of 10% of the annual fee; non-payment beyond the 60-day grace period empowers the Registrar to strike off the IC without further notice. Reinstatement requires all arrears, a reinstatement fee up to VUV 50,000, and agent approval. False statements in the annual return are punishable by fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years, with continuing daily default fines until corrected.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends or distributions made by an International Company to non-resident shareholders; dropshipping profits may be repatriated freely without Vanuatu fiscal formalities.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; its bilateral instruments are limited to tax information exchange agreements. Upon request, the VFSC and the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management issue a Certificate of Good Standing and a letter confirming the IC's statutory tax exemption, which is a factual certificate of non-taxation rather than a treaty-based TRC. Foreign-source withholding and anti-hybrid consequences must be analysed in the remitting jurisdiction because no DTA relief is available.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu withholding: 0% on royalties and 0% on interest paid by the IC to non-resident licensors or lenders. No treaty rates apply; outbound brand-licence or shareholder-loan payments should be documented by executed agreements and substance evidence to satisfy foreign anti-avoidance review.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None - Vanuatu has not enacted transfer-pricing legislation, Local File or Master File requirements, CbCR thresholds, or any VUV-denominated documentation threshold applicable to International Companies. Foreign tax authorities in customer and supplier markets may nonetheless apply OECD transfer-pricing and permanent-establishment tests to the ISIC 4791 model.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Vanuatu law does not codify transfer-pricing methods; the following OECD-compliant methods are the accepted international benchmarks applied to the IC's cross-border purchases, resales, commissions, and licensing flows.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations analogous to BVI/Cayman; however, the International Companies Act [Cap 222] confines the IC to offshore business, and VFSC good-standing review, the AML/CTF Act 2014, and Stripe/PayPal underwriting impose substance expectations: genuine order documentation, supplier contracts, decision-making minutes, active payment-rail usage, and auditable profit attribution. Operation as a pure shell results in de facto shell treatment for fiscal-crime and payment-rail termination purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false statements in the IC annual return or tax-status certificates; using the tax-exempt IC to conceal taxable trading profits from foreign revenue authorities; fabricating invoices to claim non-existent VAT or customs refunds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the Penal Code [Cap 135]: fines of up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years for false declarations; foreign tax penalties can reach 200% of the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts pierce the corporate veil where the IC is a façade; directors are jointly and severally liable for full restitution of evaded taxes, face personal asset freezes, domestic and INTERPOL-coordinated travel bans, extradition under mutual legal assistance, and custody for the statutory term.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Misuse and Deficient Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a pure shell: no board minutes, no physical records, nominee-only shareholders, dormant bank or payment rails, no supplier contracts or order logs, and reliance solely on the Vanuatu exemption as the business rationale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar strike-off after 60-day fee default; VFSC revocation of good standing; reinstatement fee up to VUV 50,000 plus arrears; global MATCH-list blacklisting by Stripe and PayPal; retroactive revocation of the tax exemption for abuse of the IC regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who trade after strike-off are personally liable for all post-strike-off debts; disqualification orders, seizure of personal assets under civil recovery, and loss of personal banking relationships in OECD correspondent networks apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to disclose ultimate beneficial owners; processing payments for sanctioned or high-risk parties; laundering credit-card charge-backs or micro-transaction proceeds; refusing source-of-funds evidence to the agent, Stripe, or PayPal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2014: body corporate fines up to VUV 100,000,000; natural-person fines up to VUV 30,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 15 years for money-laundering predicates; confiscation and freezing orders over IC assets and payment-rail balances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Knowingly involved directors are individually criminally liable; personal bank and crypto-wallet balances are confiscable, travel bans are imposed pending extradition, imprisonment up to 15 years applies, and the director may be added to global de-risking lists.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Financial Services and Dropshipping Payment Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as an unlicensed payment intermediary: collecting Stripe/PayPal proceeds for third-party merchants, charging unauthorised commissions, presenting false merchant descriptors, or exceeding processor charge-back thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Merchant account termination and MATCH-list blacklisting; VFSC fines up to VUV 5,000,000 for IC misuse; Penal Code fraud sanctions; foreign regulators may impose unlicensed money-transmitter penalties in customer markets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for restitution to processors and consumers; civil judgments enforce against foreign assets; travel bans and border-stop orders may issue; asset forfeiture applies; imprisonment up to 12 years for financial fraud is available under the Penal Code.
